```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)  # convenient for date operations
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)
library(data.table)
library(rphydro)
library(Rprebasso)
library(patchwork)
library(PlantFATE)
library(akima)
library(here)
```

## Simulations

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

# --- Nitrogen values you want to test
nitrogen_values <- seq(0.0001, 100, length.out = 10)

dt <- 1/12
start_year <- 1960
end_year <- 2022
years_seq <- seq(start_year, end_year, dt)

# Store all simulations here
all_results <- vector("list", length(nitrogen_values))

param_file <- here("tests", "params", "p_test_boreal.ini")
weather_file <- here("tests", "data", "ERAS_Monthly.csv")

for (n_idx in seq_along(nitrogen_values)) {
  
  cat("Running simulation for soil nitrogen =", nitrogen_values[n_idx], "\n")
  
  # --- Create optimizer
  lho <- new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, param_file)
  lho$set_i_metFile(weather_file)
  lho$set_a_metFile(weather_file)
  lho$set_co2File("")
  lho$set_soil_nitrogen(nitrogen_values[n_idx])
  lho$init()
  
  col_names <- lho$get_header()
  results <- vector("list", length(years_seq))
  
  i <- 1
  
  for (t in years_seq) {
    
    results[[i]] <- tryCatch({
      lho$grow_for_dt(t, dt)
      state <- lho$get_state(t + dt)
      df_row <- as.data.frame(t(state))
      names(df_row) <- col_names
      df_row
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error at t=", t, ": ", e$message)
      setNames(as.data.frame(as.list(rep(NA, length(col_names)))), col_names)
    })
    
    i <- i + 1
  }
  
  # Combine results
  df <- do.call(rbind, results)
  names(df) <- col_names
  
  # Add date column
  dates <- seq(as.Date(paste0(start_year, "-01-01")),
               as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-01-01")), by = "month")[1:nrow(df)]
  
  df$date <- dates
  df$soil_nitrogen <- nitrogen_values[n_idx]
  
  all_results[[n_idx]] <- df
}

# --- Combine ALL nitrogen simulations into one data frame
final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)

```

## Fitness

```{r}

fitness <- function(costs, nitrogen) {
  out <- costs - nitrogen
  return(out)
}


final_df$fitness <- fitness(
  costs = final_df$total_mass + 
    final_df$rs + final_df$rr + final_df$rl +
    final_df$tl + final_df$tr,
  nitrogen = final_df$nitrogen_uptake
)

```

## Trade offs: Root traits

```{r}
# First plot
p1 <- ggplot(final_df, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no, color = fitness)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen",
    y = "Root Number",
    color = "Fitness",
    title = "Fitness vs Root Number"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Second plot
p2 <- ggplot(final_df, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length, color = fitness)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen",
    y = "Root Length",
    color = "Fitness",
    title = "Fitness vs Root Length"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Display side by side
p1 + p2


```

## Trade offs: Ectomycorrhizal biomass

```{r}

ggplot(final_df, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass, color = fitness)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.8) +  # small random jitter
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen",
    y = "Ectomycorrhiza Biomass",
    color = "Fitness",
    title = "Fitness over Biomass and Soil Nitrogen"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


interp_grid <- with(final_df[!is.na(final_df$ectomycorrhiza_mass),], akima::interp(
  x = soil_nitrogen,
  y = ectomycorrhiza_mass,
  z = fitness,
  nx = 100, ny = 100,
  duplicate = TRUE
))

grid_df <- expand.grid(
  soil_nitrogen = interp_grid$x,
  ectomycorrhiza_mass = interp_grid$y
)
grid_df$fitness <- as.vector(interp_grid$z)

ggplot(grid_df, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass, z = fitness)) +
  geom_contour_filled() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen",
    y = "Ectomycorrhiza Biomass",
    fill = "Fitness",
    title = "Contour Plot of Fitness"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
